title: Fast Prime Nim
math: Give an algorithm computing $G(n)$ for all $n\le10^{12}$ in time $o(N^{1.5})$ and run it.

title: Square-plus-one orbits rarely loop
math: Prove the set of $n$ whose orbit under $Q(n)=P(n^2+1)$ is eventually periodic has natural density 0.

title: Kakeya R^3 (pre-2025)
math: Prove every Kakeya set in R^3 has Hausdorff dimension 3.

title: Unattained hyperbolic sofa
math: Find $\kappa_0$ such that for curvature $-\kappa<-\kappa_0$ the hyperbolic sofa supremum is not attained.

title: Midpoint-prime orbit lengths
math: For the midpoint-prime map $m$, prove $\frac1x\sum_{n\le x}\frac{T_m(n)}{\log n}\to c$ and compute $c$, where $T_m(n)=\min\{k:m^k(n)=1\}$.

title: Bunyakovsky n²+1
math: Prove there are infinitely many primes of the form n²+1.

title: Lonely runner
math: Prove that for any n distinct positive integer speeds v_i, sup_t min_i ||t v_i|| ≥ 1/(n+1).

title: Discrete sofa
math: Let $D(k)$ be the maximal number of cells of a polyomino that can pass the width-$k$ L-shaped corridor of $\mathbb{Z}^2$ by unit translations and $90^\circ$ rotations about lattice points (staying inside at all times). Prove $D(k)\sim ck^2$ and find $c$.

title: Plane colouring
math: Determine the chromatic number of the plane (points at distance 1 get different colours).

title: Erdős–Straus
math: Prove 4/n = 1/x+1/y+1/z has a solution in positive integers for every n≥2.

title: BB(5), compressed
math: Prove $BB(5)=47{,}176{,}870$ in Lean 4 in under 10,000 lines.

title: Graceful trees
math: Prove every tree with m edges has an injective labeling V→{0,…,m} with all edge differences distinct.

title: The 7p+4 dozen
math: Prove every orbit of $p\mapsto P(7p+4)$ on primes enters a single cycle of length 12, and identify it.

title: Goldbach
math: Prove every even integer greater than 2 is a sum of two primes.

title: Real-rank hyperoperation uniqueness
math: Prove uniqueness of an analytic family $a[s]b$ on $s\in[1,3]$ under the recursion law plus a log-convexity condition in $s$, and existence.

title: Twin primes
math: Prove there are infinitely many primes p with p+2 prime.

title: Sensitivity (pre-2019)
math: Prove the sensitivity of every Boolean function is at least a polynomial in its degree.

title: Fluid in a box blows up
math: Construct smooth $f$ such that 3D Navier–Stokes with no-slip in the unit cube blows up in finite time.

title: Collatz
math: Prove every orbit of n→n/2 (n even), 3n+1 (n odd) reaches 1.

title: Chess on the hat board
math: Weakly solve the game with standard chess move semantics translated to the hat graph on a fixed 64-tile patch.

title: Affine prime maps all settle
math: Prove that for all fixed integers $a\ge2$, $b\ge1$, every orbit of $p\mapsto P(ap+b)$ on primes is eventually periodic.

title: Square-sum chains (pre-2018)
math: Prove that for all N≥25, the numbers 1..N can be ordered so that adjacent pairs sum to perfect squares.

title: Cap sets (pre-2016)
math: Prove the largest subset of F_3^n with no three distinct points on a line has size O(c^n) for some c<3.

title: Sofa for every angle
math: For every $\theta\in(0,\pi)$, determine the optimal sofa for the width-1 corridor turning by $\theta$.
